preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[:2]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in [int(stdin.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n and m where 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()[:2]) and 1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains three integers ai, bi, ci where 1 ≤ ai < bi ≤ n and 1 ≤ ci ≤ m, with no duplicate edges of the same color between the same pair of vertices.
The next line contains an integer q where 1 ≤ q ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+q])
preconditions.description: Each of the next q lines contains two integers ui and vi where 1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n and ui ≠ vi.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.strip()) == 1 and line.strip().isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each query, stdout contains exactly one line with a non-negative integer representing the answer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= m for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: The answer for each query is the count of distinct colors ci such that there exists a path between ui and vi using only edges of color ci.
